description: A heavy-stock poster, its edges scorched like it was printed too close to something on fire. Kiyo stands hip-deep in a nest of torn cabling and cracked-open server towers, sleeves shoved past the elbow, a soldering iron in one fist and a length of live wire in the other, sparks hanging frozen around a face that hasn't slept and doesn't intend to. Behind him a dead machine is grinding back to life at his say-so. KIYO — HE DOESN'T FIX THE MACHINE. HE MAKES IT AFRAID OF HIM. Stencilled below in service-manual type: "give him ten minutes and a junction box and he'll hand you a weapon, a bomb, or a way out — his call." A real strand of copper wire is threaded through two punched holes, worried bright by passing thumbs.
name: hero poster: KIYO, THE GRID-BREAKER
